name: two symmetric populations with pairwise and three-body infection
question: Which changes turn the epidemic model with higher-order infection into a symmetric switch?
closure: An individual-based mean-field closure replaces joint infection probabilities by products of node-level infection probabilities; within each population nodes are topologically equivalent, and the populations use the symmetric constraints d_1=d_4, d_2=d_3, and h_1=h_2. The physical state space is restricted by 0<=y_1<=1 and 0<=y_2<=1.
observable: The paper plots the phase portrait, equilibrium branches, basin boundaries, and time evolution of the two infection probabilities, including four coexisting stable endemic states.
assumptions: SIS epidemic dynamics with recovery and no explicit susceptible replenishment term
Symmetric coupling between the two populations
Pairwise interactions both within and between populations

provenance.source: I. Z. Kiss, C. Bick and P. L. Simon, Decoding how higher-order network interactions shape complex contagion dynamics, J. Math. Biol. 91, 29 (2025), doi:10.1007/s00285-025-02247-4, arXiv:2410.15330
